title: TFTP Configuration Backup and Restore
summary: Back up Cisco IOS running configuration to a centralized TFTP server over UDP port 69, simulate a catastrophic router configuration loss, and execute full disaster recovery and state restoration.
learning_objectives: Explain the protocol mechanics and architectural role of the Trivial File Transfer Protocol (TFTP) in enterprise network management
Execute an interactive Cisco IOS running configuration backup to a remote TFTP server over UDP port 69 using 'copy running-config tftp:'
Verify file transmission integrity and inspect stored configuration archives on the TFTP server filesystem
Simulate a catastrophic router configuration alteration and test systematic disaster recovery procedures using 'copy tftp: running-config'
Validate that restored router parameters, hostnames, interface states, and system banners match the pre-disaster operational baseline
Diagnose common TFTP transfer failures, including non-existent archive filenames, server IP typos, and UDP reachability timeouts

source.origin: Independently authored network services curriculum guide based on IETF RFC 1350 (The TFTP Protocol Revision 2) standards
